in_sanskrit.name: अनिर्वान
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anirvan in Sanskrit is a name derived from the word 'anirvana' which means 'free from desires, desireless'. This name is often given to those who have attained a state of spiritual liberation and have transcended worldly desires and attachments.

in_hindi.name: अनिर्वान
in_hindi.long_meaning: Anirvan in Hindi is a name that translates to 'apamana purush', which means 'a person without any desire or attachment'. This name is often given to those who have attained a high level of spiritual enlightenment and have transcended worldly desires and attachments.

in_tamil.name: அநிர்வான
in_tamil.long_meaning: Anirvan in Tamil is a name that translates to 'avviyodu veer', which means 'a person who is free from all desires and attachments'. This name is often given to those who have attained a high level of spiritual enlightenment and have transcended worldly desires and attachments.

in_telugu.name: అనిర్వాన
in_telugu.long_meaning: Anirvan in Telugu is a name that translates to 'apradheshya', which means 'one who is beyond all rules and regulations'. This name is often given to those who have attained a high level of spiritual enlightenment and have transcended worldly desires and attachments.

in_marathi.name: Anirvan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beyond the Annihilation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anirvan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is beyond the cycle of birth, death and rebirth. One who has achieved the ultimate goal of human life - moksha or liberation.

in_bengali.name: Anirvan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Beyond the Annihilation
in_bengali.long_meaning: Anirvan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is beyond the cycle of birth, death and rebirth. One who has achieved the ultimate goal of human life - moksha or liberation.
